entities.name: ZipA (A9MIF9)
observations: Exact 326-aa sequence match to reviewed Salmonella arizonae ZipA (UniProt A9MIF9); predicted mass 36.1 kDa and pI 5.26.
ZipA is an inner-membrane anchor for the FtsZ Z ring; stabilizes/cross-links FtsZ protofilaments and supports recruitment of downstream septal proteins.
Sequence has an N-terminal hydrophobic membrane anchor and a low-complexity, proline/glutamine-rich central region; Pfam ZipA_C domain spans residues 192–317.
